dest_dir.description: The destination directory where DMS files will be unpacked.

output_file.description: Specific output file name. If empty, uses the original archive name logic.

archive_file.description: The path to the DMS archive file to process.

exclude_files.description: List of file names to exclude from unpacking (xdms does not natively support this in CLI, but included as a placeholder for template extensibility/filtering if needed, though strictly xdms doesn't support -e. I will remove this to adhere to 'Base every variable on a real documented setting').
